title.narrative: Building effective health systems for impactful malaria control - Ghana (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Ghana, Malaria, Ministry of Health of the Republic of Ghana (Ghana MOH)This program has the following goals: To reduce the malaria morbidity and mortality by 75% (using 2012 as baseline) by the year 2020. The objectives of this program are: To protect at least 80% of the population with effective malaria prevention interventions by 2020. To provide parasitological diagnosis to all suspected malaria cases and provide prompt and effective treatment to 100% of confirmed malaria cases by 2020. To strengthen and maintain the capacity for programme management, partnership and coordination to achieve malaria programmatic objectives at all levels of the health care system by 2020. To strengthen the systems for surveillance and M&E in order to ensure timely availability of quality, consistent and relevant malaria data at all levels by 2020. To increase awareness and knowledge of the entire population on malaria prevention and control so as to improve uptake and correct use of all interventions by 2020
